description: The organization does not have a documented incident response plan or the plan does not address key incident handling procedures. This signal indicates that the organization may lack defined processes for detecting, responding to, and recovering from security incidents.
applicability: Applicable to any organization requiring incident response capabilities. Includes documented procedures, roles and responsibilities, communication protocols, and recovery processes.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through documentation review, policy assessment, and verification of incident response procedures and playbooks.
